_doc: Space encounters rolled during warp. Choice keys: cost (credits, x bribe_mult when bribe=true), requires {flag|min_credits|has_item|crew_size_min}, chance (0..1) + chance_mods {'flag:liar': 0.2, 'perk:silver_tongue': 0.15}, then success/fail or result -> {text, effects}. Effects: credits, credits_pct, hp, rep{}, bounty{}, clear_bounty, items{}, record{verb,target_faction,public}, recruit (id|'random'), skill_points, flag{}, mishap, air_debt, ai (ShipAI line key). Text tokens: {bounty} {credits} {air_debt} {bribe}. requires/choice requires also accept the shared requirement grammar (any_flag, tag, age, min_wealth, min_air_debt...; see data/interactions.json). Effects also: mods (permanent stat source), heal_full, sell_all.

list.title: GHOST SHIP
list.text: A derelict liner, the 'Quarterly Projection', drifts across your lane. Every window is dark except one, which spells out WE ARE CLOSED.

success.text: You find a stash of unclaimed severance packages and a working medkit. Nobody is left to claim them.

fail.text: Something in the dark bills you for the visit. In blood. You leave with a scrap of hull and a new fear.

success.text: One pod still hums. You thaw its occupant. They look at you, then at the Odd Duck, and decide you're the lesser evil.

fail.text: All pods read EMPTY - REPOSSESSED. You mark the wreck for the next fool.

result.text: QUACK plays a mournful kazoo solo as the ghost ship fades behind you.

list.title: DISTRESS SIGNAL
list.text: "MAYDAY... hull breach... please help... also, pre-order our debut album, out now on Lumen."

success.text: It's real. A smuggler named Pip is stuck in a leaking shuttle. They're grateful. Suspiciously grateful.

fail.text: It's a pirate ambush. They board, take a 'convenience fee', and leave you a one-star review.

result.text: The signal fades. You'll never know. Your crew will bring it up later, though.
Paragon thanks you for your civic engagement and charges you a 5-credit processing fee.

list.title: COMPLIANCE CHECKPOINT
list.text: A Paragon cruiser hails you: "Random inspection. You have been randomly selected by our completely random algorithm, which selected you specifically."

result.text: They scan you, fine you 10% of your savings for 'having savings', and wish you a compliant day.

success.text: The officer pockets it. "Have a safe flight, valued customer."

fail.text: "Attempted bribery of a Compliance Officer is a premium offence." They keep the money anyway.

success.text: The Odd Duck coughs, wheezes and somehow outruns a military cruiser. QUACK is insufferable about it.

fail.text: They clip your engines with a 'warning shot' that was not a warning.

list.title: AD DRONE LATCHED
list.text: An Ad Drone magnetically clamps onto your hull. "Watch thirty seconds of content to unlock your vessel!"

result.text: You watch a man in a suit eat Protein Paste and weep with joy. You receive 15 credits and a faint craving.
The drone explodes mid-jingle. Lumen's legal department has been notified automatically.

success.text: You redirect its advertising budget to yourself. Capitalism works!

fail.text: The drone counter-hacks you and subscribes the Odd Duck to 40 newsletters.

list.title: BOUNTY HUNTER
list.text: A hunter-ship named 'Due Diligence' matches your velocity. "There's {bounty} credits on your head, friend. Nothing personal. It's in my KPIs."

result.text: The hunter accepts payment and emails you a receipt titled 'Your Freedom (Temporary)'.

success.text: The 'Due Diligence' limps away. You salvage its bounty board, which oddly lists you as 'paid'.

fail.text: You barely escape. The hunter leaves a sticky note on your hull: 'See you next quarter.'

choices.text: Claim you're your own evil twin

success.text: "Oh. Sorry. Wrong twin." The hunter leaves to harass your nonexistent sibling.

fail.text: "That's what the real one would say." Shots fired.

list.title: LUMEN EXCLUSIVE
list.text: A Lumen news-skiff pulls alongside. A reporter with nine cameras for a face asks for 'your side of the story'. Which story? Every story.

choices.text: Spin it. You're the hero here.

success.text: The segment airs. You're 'a misunderstood entrepreneur'. Paragon lowers your bounty to avoid bad press.

fail.text: They edit your interview into a crime documentary. It's a hit.

result.text: Lumen has never aired the truth before. Ratings explode. Your crew looks at you differently.
The headline reads: DRIFTER REFUSES TO DENY EVERYTHING.

list.title: FREE SAMPLE
list.text: A Gristle promo-pod offers a complimentary tube of NEW Protein Paste Lite(tm): 'Now with 12% less mystery!'

success.text: Surprisingly nutritious. You feel 12% less mysterious.

fail.text: It was the recalled batch. It contained a tooth. Not yours. Not human.

choices.text: Resell it to your crew at a markup

result.text: Your crew pays 20 credits. Some of them will remember this.
The pod plays a sad trombone and logs you as a 'low-value consumer'.

list.title: OVERDUE NOTICE
list.text: Halcyon Debt & Trust: "Our records show {air_debt} credits of unpaid breathing. Please remit, or we will be forced to repossess your lungs."

result.text: Debt cleared. Halcyon sends a 'We'll miss you' card. It's a threat.

success.text: You restructure the debt into a smaller debt with a bigger font. Halcyon accepts.

fail.text: They restructure your debt upward. With fees for restructuring.

result.text: Halcyon flags your account. A repossession drone has your scent now.

list.title: CRYO AUCTION
list.text: A Halcyon auction barge is selling 'pre-owned humans' in cryo. One pod's label reads: 'Barely used. Has opinions.'

result.text: You buy a person to set them free. Halcyon calls it 'a great deal'. Your new crewmate calls it 'complicated'.

choices.text: Steal the pod during the auction

success.text: You swap the pod with a crate of Protein Paste. Nobody notices for hours.

fail.text: Alarms. You escape empty-handed and very much on camera.

result.text: The auctioneer shouts 'SOLD!' behind you. To whom, you'll never know.

list.title: FAMILY YACHT
list.text: A gold-plated yacht drops out of warp beside you. Your family crest fills the viewscreen. "Come home. The board is asking questions."

choices.text: Dock for dinner and play the dutiful heir

result.text: Twelve courses, eleven threats, one cheque. You leave richer and colder.
Silence on the line. Then: "Then you're cut off." The yacht leaves. You feel lighter. And poorer.

choices.text: Dock - and empty the family vault on the way out

success.text: You leave with the silverware, the art, and a hard drive of family secrets.

fail.text: Security was waiting. They always are, in this family.

list.title: DRIFTING POD
list.text: A battered escape pod tumbles past. Inside: three people with Halcyon collateral barcodes, waving frantically.

result.text: They cry, they eat everything, they promise to repay you. One of them actually might.

choices.text: Pass them supplies and a star chart (a medkit)

result.text: You float a crate across. They salute you through the glass.

choices.text: Report the escaped assets to Halcyon

result.text: Halcyon's tow-drone arrives in minutes. The finder's fee is generous. The silence afterwards is not.

choices.text: "I've got a barcode too." Tell them where to hide

result.text: You give them coordinates for a moon Halcyon forgot it owns. They'll be safe there. So might you, one day.

list.title: LUMEN LIVE: DEBT OR DOUBLE
list.text: A Lumen camera-drone locks onto your ship. "CONGRATULATIONS! You've been selected for DEBT OR DOUBLE! Bet your credits - live!"

success.text: DOUBLE! The studio audience screams. Your mum calls. You don't have a mum. Someone calls.

fail.text: DEBT! The confetti is billed to you.

choices.text: Use the airtime to plug yourself

result.text: You hijack the segment. Ratings spike. Lumen pays you to leave.
"WOW. Okay. A REFUSER, folks!" Somewhere, a meme is born.

list.title: THE FREE BREATH
list.text: A patched-together cathedral ship broadcasts hymns about free air. "Brother, sister, other - will you breathe with us?"

result.text: They sing your name. Badly. Beautifully.
Your sermon is broadcast to six systems. Pilgrims will look for you now.

choices.text: Mock them over the open channel

result.text: Half the congregation laughs. The other half adds you to a prayer list. It's unclear which list.
The hymns follow you for a while, then fade into static.

list.title: PASTE SPILL
list.text: A Gristle freighter has split open. A slow river of grey paste drifts through space, glinting under the stars.

result.text: You fill the hold with paste. The ship smells of it for weeks.
Gristle thanks you with a coupon. For paste.

choices.text: Sell the wreck's location to scavengers

result.text: By the time Gristle arrives, there's nothing left but a very clean hole in space.
The crew is alive, abandoned by Gristle. You patch them up and take them to port. They won't forget it.

list.title: PRE-WAR SIGNAL
list.text: An ancient satellite, older than the Consortium, broadcasts a looping message in a language almost like yours.

result.text: It's a weather report. Rain, light winds, no charge. Your crew listens in silence.
You understand every word. It's a lullaby your mother sang. Nobody else on board can see why you're crying.
Pre-war circuits sell high. The lullaby stops mid-verse.

list.title: HALCYON REPO BLOCKADE
list.text: Halcyon repo-cutters surround the Odd Duck. "ACCOUNT {air_debt} CR OVERDUE. SURRENDER THE VESSEL OR PAY."

result.text: They take everything you have and leave you the ship. For now.

success.text: The Duck screams through the blockade with paint scraping off both sides.

fail.text: A tractor beam. A fine. A very long apology form.

choices.text: Cite the Deep Space Grace Period

result.text: There is no such thing. You say it with such confidence that the cutters back off to check.

choices.text: Hail them with the Halcyon family code

result.text: The cutters scatter like startled birds. Somebody's getting fired for this.

list.title: STRIKE CONVOY
list.text: A rag-tag convoy of striking miners hails you. "Paragon's hunting us. Escort us to the next system?"

success.text: You lead them through an asteroid field Paragon won't follow into. They name a mining drill after you.

fail.text: Paragon catches up. The Duck takes hits covering the convoy's escape. Most of them make it.

result.text: Paragon pays promptly. The convoy's distress calls do not stop for a long time.
They fly on without you. Some of them wave.

list.title: BLACK-MARKET CLINIC
list.text: A medical barge with no registration offers 'discount upgrades, no questions, minimal screaming'.

choices.text: Get a cheap reflex implant (90 cr)

success.text: It works. Your hands move before you think. Mostly in a good way.

fail.text: It works, sort of. It also plays an ad jingle when you sneeze.

result.text: They take a little more than agreed. Everyone does.
You fix six botched implants and save a life. They pay you in meds.

list.title: THE OTHER DUCK
list.text: A ship identical to the Odd Duck drops out of warp. On the viewscreen: a face exactly like yours.

result.text: "I was going to ask you the same thing." The other ship warps away. QUACK refuses to discuss it.
They nod slowly. "There are more of us. Find the others." They transmit a list of names. Yours is crossed out.

success.text: They flee, trailing smoke. You feel strangely guilty, like you shot a mirror.

fail.text: They shoot back exactly like you would. It's very annoying.
